entries.body: You fill my thoughts constantly. Every song I hear, every activity I throw myself into, every second my mind drifts for a moment, you're there. It's strange how still everything suddenly feels, now that time used to fly by so fast. Everything moves slowly now, and there's endless time, endless empty space. You've always said I think I know best. Now I truly know something. I know you've known best the whole time, and that I should have listened. I've never been good at receiving love, even though I've always wanted to be. And you did try. I felt it so many times, and we had so many romantic, wonderful moments together that I'll never forget. If you ever held a little of your love back so you wouldn't seem too into me, I understand it completely. It's nothing I blame you for. It just makes me sad at myself, that I didn't make it feel safe enough to let all of it out. I love you with all my heart. But I understand why you hesitated. When you called last week to check if I was okay, I let myself believe for a moment it meant something special, until I realized that's just who you are. You would have done it for anyone. It's in everything you do, whether it's your sister, your mom, or your friends. I envy that way of seeing life, and I wish I could become the best at sending it back your way, because I'm sure you'd love to be on the receiving end of it too. When I came to say thank you and saw you again, I don't know how to describe what happened in me. It was as if all the time and distance between us had suddenly been crossed out, and I felt an infatuation I'd never felt before. Maybe that's the difference between ordinary infatuation and the one person meant for you: being in love on top of loving someone. I regret it so deeply. It's insane to think how little it would have taken. We could have just talked things through. I could have listened, understood, changed my behavior. And I know it takes a lot of repeating, and a lot of getting through to me, before something actually sinks in. I've held back, the whole time. Never truly let myself listen to your love and take it all in, even though again and again I've caught myself feeling so tender about your feelings after a bad moment, without being able to open my own and let yours all the way in. I know words don't carry much weight after everything that's happened. Only actions do. So I'm not promising anything with words today. I'm just going to show you, day by day, until you can feel it without having to believe it. I'm completely certain I want to spend the rest of my life with you. I've never in my life been this in love, and I want to give you room to teach me, so we become a kind of symbiosis, where we share feelings, vulnerability, and still have ridiculous, childish fun alongside it all. Fuck, I miss when we used to be silly together, babe.
